name: 圣骑士的荣耀
description: 提里奥被召唤时，若尚未拥有圣盾则获得圣盾保护
skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; var summoned = context.sourcePiece; if (!piece || !summoned || summoned.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (!piece.statusTags) piece.statusTags = []; if (piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'divine-shield'; })) return { success: false, message: '' }; piece.statusTags.push({ id: 'divine-shield', type: 'divine-shield', name: '圣盾', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-divine-shield'] }); if (!(piece.rules || []).find(function(r) { return r.id === 'rule-divine-shield'; })) addRuleById(piece.instanceId, 'rule-divine-shield'); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '散发出神圣光辉，获得圣盾保护！' };
